result.reason: The operative clause meets every preferred insurance type, limit, conditional cyber requirement, and certificate obligation; it therefore also exceeds the lower fallback E&O and cyber limits. The preexisting risk-of-loss language remains unchanged. Requiring coverage at IBM's expense throughout the Term is directly related to implementing the insurance obligation, and no unrelated obligation or post-termination tail was added.
